title: The stale-draft list holds every PR the batch runner holds or that has a review record
why: The R45 part 2 re-run at 23:47 CST closed #2793 and #2818, which runner 10 held for the batch 110 rebuild (#2818 is step merge-reads-ruleset, head branch lane-ruleset-read). Triage reopened both at 23:50 CST. The build row sees a lane only when its branch equals its cs-step tag, and the join used archive pass 2's lane pairs and the first pass's holds, but not runner 10's hand-in and hold list.
source: coordinator 23:50 CST Nov 12; triage incident at 23:47 CST
note: Fix in skills/roadmap/build.py (the stale-draft row) or its live file: hold a draft that (1) the batch runner's hand-in or hold list names, or (2) carries a posted review record (handed in, never stale). Red test first with #2818's shape: branch differs from the step id, the lane has no live session, a review record is posted. Until it lands, triage asks runner 10 for its list before each pass. Checked against the 73 closed at 23:47 CST: only #2793 and #2818 overlap, both reopened 23:50 CST. Both are open drafts that conflict with main a11bafe09; their lanes need a merge-main fix before they batch.
